pages.english:
Chapter One
Torn, Ripped, Ruined

My name is Nate the Great.
I am a detective.
My dog, Sludge, is a detective too.
“Ouch!”
Right now I am a mumbling, bumbling, tripping detective.
I have just tripped over a big pile of books that Rosamond left in my house.
pages.translate:
第一章 撕裂、破损、毁坏

我叫内特·大侦探。 我是一名侦探。 我的狗，斯拉奇，也是侦探。 “哎哟！” 现在，我是一个喃喃自语、笨手笨脚、绊倒的侦探。 我刚刚被罗莎蒙德留在我家的一大堆书绊倒了。
pages.explain: 第一章题目是 Torn, Ripped, Ruined，撕破、扯破、毁掉。故事开头，小朋友自我介绍：My name is Nate the Great. 他是侦探，detective 就是专门查案子的人。他的狗 Sludge 也是侦探。他刚喊了一声 Ouch，因为被 Rosamond 留在家里的 a pile of books 绊倒了。pile 就是一堆。咱们先把这几句读顺。
segments: My name is Nate the Great.
My dog, Sludge, is a detective too.
“Ouch!” Right now I am a mumbling, bumbling, tripping detective.
I have just tripped over a big pile of books that Rosamond left in my house.

pages.english: Sludge is sniffing them. He has been sniffing them since Rosamond knocked on my door this morning. She was carrying a bunch of books. Three more were piled on her head. Rosamond looked very strange. Rosamond looks strange all the time. "I have great news," she said. "I have started a book club. I am calling it Rosamond's Ready Readers. But there is trouble in the club. One of the members is trying to wreck my cookbook. Look!" Rosamond took a book off her head. The other two books fell off. "Why are you carrying books on top of your head?" I asked. "Because I'm president of a club now.
pages.translate: 淤泥正在嗅它们。自从罗莎蒙德今天早上敲我的门以来，他就一直在嗅它们。她带着一堆书。她头上还堆了三本书。罗莎蒙德看起来很奇怪。罗莎蒙德一直看起来很奇怪。“我有个好消息，”她说，“我成立了一个读书俱乐部。我把它叫做罗莎蒙德的准备读者。但俱乐部里出了问题。一个成员试图破坏我的烹饪书。看！”罗莎蒙德从她头上拿下一本书，另外两本书掉了下来。“你为什么要把书顶在头上？”我问。“因为我现在是俱乐部的主席。”
pages.explain: Sludge 一直在 sniffing，就是用鼻子闻那些书。早上 Rosamond 敲门进来，怀里抱着 a bunch of books，头上还顶着三本。她说好消息：自己办了个 book club，叫 Rosamond's Ready Readers。可是俱乐部里有麻烦，有人想 wreck 她的 cookbook。wreck 是搞坏，cookbook 是食谱书。她从脑袋上拿下一本，另外两本掉下来。Nate 问她为什么把书顶在头上，她说因为自己现在是 president，主席。
segments: Sludge is sniffing them. He has been sniffing them since Rosamond knocked on my door this morning. She was carrying a bunch of books. Three more were piled on her head. Rosamond looked very strange. Rosamond looks strange all the time.
"I have great news," she said. "I have started a book club. I am calling it Rosamond's Ready Readers. But there is trouble in the club. One of the members is trying to wreck my cookbook.
Look!" Rosamond took a book off her head. The other two books fell off. "Why are you carrying books on top of your head?" I asked. "Because I'm president of a club now.

pages.english: These books help me hold my head high and look like a president.” I, Nate the Great, knew that I was looking at a very strange president.
pages.translate: “这些书帮助我昂首挺胸，看起来像个总统。” 我，大侦探内特，知道我看到的是一个非常奇怪的总统。
pages.explain: Rosamond 解释：These books help me hold my head high and look like a president. hold my head high 是把头抬高，显得很神气。Nate 心里想，这可是个 very strange president，strange 就是奇怪。书顶在头上当主席，他觉得这件事本身就很怪。
segments: These books help me hold my head high and look like a president.” I, Nate the Great, knew that I was looking at a very strange president.

pages.english:
“This is my new cookbook,” she said.
“Yesterday I left it open on my kitchen table after I made treats for the club meeting.
When the meeting was over, I went to get the treats for the members.
The page that was open was torn, ripped, ruined!”
Sludge and I looked at the page.
I, Nate the Great, say that it was torn, ripped, ruined.
pages.translate:
“这是我的新食谱，”她说。  
“昨天我在为俱乐部会议做点心后，把它打开放在厨房的桌子上。  
会议结束后，我去拿给会员们的点心。  
那页打开的书页被撕了、扯了、毁了！”  
斯拉奇和我看了那页。  
我，大侦探内特，说那页被撕了、扯了、毁了。
pages.explain: Rosamond 拿出那本新 cookbook。昨天她做好 club meeting 的 treats，点心，把书打开放在 kitchen table 上。会开完去拿点心，发现摊开的那一页 torn, ripped, ruined，撕了、扯了、毁了。Nate 和 Sludge 看了一眼，他也重复这三个词。这一章的谜就在这儿：谁把食谱页弄坏了。
